name: Linter
description: Tidies a note's Markdown by rules you choose: trailing spaces, extra blank lines, space around headings, one kind of bullet. Format note in the command palette, or an AI formats a note or a folder.

trailingSpaces.label: Trailing spaces
trailingSpaces.description: spaces and tabs at the end of lines come off

blankLines.label: Extra blank lines
blankLines.description: two or more blank lines in a row become one

headingSpacing.label: Space around headings
headingSpacing.description: a blank line before and after each heading

headingSpace.label: Space after heading marks
headingSpace.description: ##Title becomes ## Title (one # is a tag, left alone)

finalNewline.label: One line break at the end
finalNewline.description: the note ends in exactly one line break
